title: Dynamics 365 Finance: ERP Analytics MCP gives agents access to Business performance analytics data
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, BPA security paths, preview limits and qualified Copilot Studio billing statements are supported. One minor correction should report Microsoft's differing guidance about automatic BPA administrator assignment, because the installation page says version 2.5 requires manual setup.
